description.value: Le Coq Frit is a Vancouver fried chicken eatery that opened on West Broadway in 2021, offering hand-battered chicken in Korean-inspired preparations (Nashville Hot, Black Soy, Sweet & Spicy) alongside signature brioche bun burgers and croissant waffles. The restaurant has a sustainability focus, using recyclable non-woven bags in place of plastic. It has a second location in North Vancouver's Lonsdale Quay.
